name: Silolona

seo.title: Silolona Phinisi: Private Yacht Charter in Indonesia
seo.description: Silolona, a 50m Konjo-built phinisi launched in 2004, charters five cabins for ten guests across Komodo, Raja Ampat, Banda and Papua. Seasons, cabins, plan.

tagline: Five cabins, seventeen crew and twenty years of Eastern Indonesia, chartered whole
answer: Silolona is a 50-metre phinisi built of tropical hardwoods by the Konjo boat builders of Sulawesi to German Lloyd specifications and launched in 2004. Five cabins, three king and two queen, take two adults each, plus child extra beds, with a crew of 17. Chartered whole: Komodo, Flores and Alor from May to September; Raja Ampat, Papua, Banda, Savu and Cenderawasih Bay from October to April.
facts: Konjo master boat builders of Sulawesi, to German Lloyd specifications
5: 3 king suites (Asmat, Java, Bali), 2 double suites (Sumba, Borneo)
overview: Silolona was launched in 2004, the first yacht of Patti Seery's Silolona Sojourns. She is a 50-metre phinisi built of tropical hardwoods by the Konjo boat builders of Sulawesi to German Lloyd specifications, with the rig of the old spice island trading boats and modern safety equipment.

She carries five cabins, each named for a part of Indonesia and hung with its art. Asmat and Java measure 4 by 6.6 metres and Bali 4 by 5.6 metres, each with a king bed; Sumba and Borneo measure 4 by 2.8 metres with queen beds. Every cabin is for two adults, and child extra beds can be added to any of them. Seventeen crew sail her, among them a captain, chefs and dive instructors.

Her year follows the monsoons: Komodo, Flores and Alor from May to September, then Raja Ampat, Tribal Papua, the Savu Sea and Sumba, Cenderawasih Bay and the Banda Islands from October to April. Routes are drawn for each charter.
why: Silolona Sojourns has worked these waters for 30 years and Patti Seery is known in Banda as Ibu Patti, which shows in where the yacht can take a group: Banda's nutmeg gardens and colonial houses, Asmat carving villages, the whale sharks under the bagans of Cenderawasih Bay.
Five cabins and seventeen crew make her one of the smaller groups afloat in Eastern Indonesia. She suits a family or two couples travelling together who want culture as much as diving.

children: Children are welcome: Silolona Sojourns can arrange child extra beds in all five cabins. No minimum age is published.
faqs: How much does it cost to charter Silolona?
Silolona Sojourns does not publish rates. She is chartered whole, for up to ten adults, and the price is quoted for each route and date. Ask James for a current quote.
Can we book a single cabin on Silolona?
No. Silolona is sold as a private charter of the whole yacht. For shared-cabin voyages in Eastern Indonesia, look at Aliikai or the cabin voyages on Rascal and Rebel.
How many guests does Silolona take?

Ten adults, two in each of her five cabins: three king suites named Asmat, Java and Bali, and two queen double suites named Sumba and Borneo. Child extra beds can be added to every cabin. She has a crew of 17.
Where and when does Silolona sail?
From May to September, Komodo, Flores and Alor. From October to April, Raja Ampat, Tribal Papua, the Savu Sea and Sumba, Cenderawasih Bay and the Banda Islands.
She was launched in 2004, built of tropical hardwoods by the Konjo boat builders of Sulawesi to German Lloyd specifications.
Yes. Diving and snorkelling are part of life aboard and the crew includes dive instructors. Waterskiing, wakeboarding, kayaking, paddleboarding and sport fishing are also on offer.
Silolona Sojourns, founded by Patti Seery, which has been chartering yachts in Indonesia for 30 years and also runs a second phinisi, Si Datu Bua.
